neighbours.label: The sides of a polygon (or the length of a vector) as geometric magnitudes, e.g. 'three equal sides', 'a, b, c = triangle'
fire: A square has four equal sides and four right angles.
An isosceles triangle has two equal sides.
A regular hexagon has six equal sides.
The magnitude of a vector is its length in space.
A rhombus is a shape whose four sides are all equal.
The Euclidean norm gives the length of a vector.
An equilateral triangle has three sides of the same length.
quiet: A square has four right angles and two diagonals.
An isosceles triangle has two equal angles.
A regular hexagon has six equal angles.
The direction of a vector is shown by its arrow.

import math

def area(r):
    s = math.pi * r * r
    return s
A rhombus is a shape whose opposite angles are equal.
The Euclidean norm is used in many fields.
An equilateral triangle has three angles of sixty degrees.
